title: The Curse of Paper Currency
body:
(Mawlana Shaykh stands) Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar, la ilaaha illa-Llah, Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar, wa
lillahi 'l-hamd! Allahuma salli wa salim wa barik `alaa ashrafi 'l-anbiya wa 'l-mursaleen, habeeb ar-Rabbi 'l`Alameen. Al-Fatihah. (Mawlana Shaykh sits)
The first month is the holiest month, Muharram al-Haram. In this month, (Mawlana Shaykh stands) Allah
Almighty grants us from heavenly support for the honor of the most honored, most glorified, and most
perfect servant and deputy of the Lord of Heavens. (Mawlana Shaykh sits) We are asking forgiveness as we
are weak servants, and we are asking Grandshaykh (q) and all holy ones who belong to the Heavens to
support us against Shaytan and its hegemony, and to make it fall down. We hope that Shaytan and its power
gets down speedily, and we hope this year will be one of the holiest years and this month is also the most
holiest month, and that is a holy promise for the believers. Believers now are weak, but really they are not
weak because heavenly powers are supporting them and there is no support for Shaytan!
We are saying, a`oodhu billahi min ash-Shaytani 'r-rajeem; we are running away from Shaytan's trips and
traps. Bismillahi 'r-Rahmani 'r-Raheem. (Mawlana Shaykh stands) O our Lord! Dress us as mu`mins from
the holiness of Bismillahi 'r-Rahmani 'r-Raheem, to be powerful, majestic, glorified ones from Heavens
against Shaytan and its trips and traps! (Mawlana Shaykh sits)

Shaytan's time is going to finish. Now Shaytan and its followers are like slaughtered animals, still kicking, but
their heads are cut! There is no more power for Shaytan to cheat people or call them to the wrong way,
finished! Therefore, we see everywhere there are troubles from the slaughtered Shaytan, kicking everywhere,
until people come to the Lord's command and try to be His weak servants. We have good tidings in this New
Year, 1432, from the Holy Pilgrimage up to today, fourteen centuries and thirty-two years. We have been
informed this 15th century is going to be the end of the world's time and the Day of Resurrection is going to
be after these fifteen centuries.
O People! Come and listen! As-salaamu `alaykum to our attenders throughout the east and west! Use your
mentalities, your minds, your understanding! Think on it, that for every beginning there must be an end, and
this world has a beginning and there must be an end. That end is coming at the end of fifteen centuries. Allah
Almighty knows. Troubles, miseries, and sufferings are now under the umbrella of shaytanic works. People
are running after Shaytan to find a new system on Earth to make them happy or to bring them to a happy life,
and that is finished! Shaytan has been given one opportunity or chance, and it is impossible for Shaytan to be
given a new chance or opportunity to cheat people.
People now are saying, and it is an awakening to ask, "What is happening to us? What is wrong with us?"
because people are seeing that there must be something wrong in themselves. If a car or train is not moving
or a plane is not flying, there must be something wrong. Throughout the world you can't find any country
now without troubles and suffering. Now they are beginning to say, "There must be something making us not
to be successful." Yes, and we are saying that Shaytan just cheated you, bringing the whole world from a high
point, making them get in its car or train, and from up, going down easily. Now they are coming to a deep
point and there is nothing. Shaytan's method is to cheat people, taking them (from goodness). They think the
best ruling is what Shaytan is bringing, and they say, "We must leave heavenly orders and find our chance to
bring from our minds' production. We must look after ourselves." Shaytan is saying, "With your thinking, you
must make so much technology, technology, technology."
Shaytan and those following Shaytan are demons. They are going up and taking people up (in space travel). If
you are finding a better place in the clouds and stars, take people! Shaytan is saying, "Wait, I am teaching you
something that you can carry an entire city's citizens in it and take them up." Now people are thinking on it,

"We can save ourselves if we go up, " and from up are some cars taking like this and like that. Shaytan is
asking to take people up and then finish them!
Technology just reached the last point and will never giving to them a sweet life; that is finished. A sweet life
is only for those who are tasting the sweetness of being servants! They have been granted a sweet life. If
anyone is asking beyond spiritual sweetness, they can't find it. They may always have been given millions or
billions worth of gold or treasure, but that treasure is never giving them a tasteful and sweet life!
O People throughout the east and west! A sweet life is only coming to you from Heavens. You can't bring it
from under your feet, no, but from over your heads it may come. You must understand what is now finished.
In every country, people are running like wild animals in the streets, saying, "We don't like that government.
We don't like those people. We don't believe in that party. We are not happy with what you are giving us."
Everywhere people are like this. Come to Allah Jalla Jalaaluh, Jalla `Azhaamatu, come to your Creator!
(Mawlana Shaykh stands and sits)
O People! Use your minds! When you were a spasm coming from the womb of your mother, Who was looking
after you there, keeping you, making that baby a happy being? All of us were happy in the wombs; only when
we came out we were crying, and for what? We lost what Allah granted to us in our mothers' wombs. We were
happy, but when we came out everything opened and we looked at the life of Man on Earth, and we saw more
than ourselves, and cried for what was happening. Everyone was crying and said, "We were so happy, now we
are falling into this bad life where so many shayaateen and its armies are making us unhappy!" Then the
babies cry and are born into this world. Who was keeping you in your mother's wombs may also keep you in
this life, as long as you are not following Shaytan! But as long as people follow Shaytan they will suffer, and
punishment and cursing must come on them.
Now everywhere signs of heavenly cursing are making people run to the streets to fight their governments,
and governments fight their people. What can governments do? Governing bodies are thinking that, "If we sit
on this chair we can do everything, we can give our people a sweet life." But now they are in regret, saying,
"We can't do it. We thought if we sit on this powerful chair, we could do everything." But now they are
looking and saying, "We can't do anything." And the people are telling them to leave that chair, but they can't
leave. They are saying so many statements on the streets in protest, and they are just hit, because that is one

person from the Children of Adam and you are making him a minister of finance, who says, "We think our
stores are full with money and we can make our people restful." But how can it be? He says, "We are not
giving people gold; we changed gold money to paper money and we were thinking that if anything happens,
we can print new money."
They can't do this. Even if they have machines to print more currency, they can't (balance their economies
now) because that is not gold. It is so easy for governments to order one billion dollars because people are
asking for money and governments are saying, "You give us money!" Everyone is the government; you have
money machines. You may go to His Holiness, the Pope, and ask what is his advice to you; if not, come to
Shaykh Nazim also.
(laughter) I have something to say to them. I am not saying it from myself, I am going to speak a heavenly
language. We are not speaking Shaytan's language, no. We must speak a holy language, and if the Holy Pope
has this, he may speak. Chief rabbis that are saying, "We are sitting on golden chairs," why are you not
printing (money)? What is your book's advice to you, to sell and buy with paper money? Why are you not
printing it? What are they putting in it? It is like money made of newspaper. (Mawlana Shaykh throws
currency to attenders, then coins.) Very happy! Very happy! (laughter) Holy rabbis, why are you not saying
anything and ordering more money? No, Allah is saying, "You must deal with gold, silver and copper." Using
paper money never happened from the beginning of Man's history. That is the main source of
"troublemakers", to change gold and silver money to paper money.
These people (Chilean miners) are coming from 700 feet underground and they are not giving paper money
to them also. Now print and give it, because Shaytan is making you to change gold and silver coins into paper,
so print and give to them as now they have no money with them. But their government is saying, "We can't
give." How? If you are the government, you must give! Print it!
You must hear the holy command. O Holy Pope, holy ones, holy rabbis, holy Buddhist people who are saying,
"We are holy ones," and lastly we are saying to Muslim learned people, `ulamas: why are you not finding a
way to make Muslims happy and enjoyful? Because you also changed gold and silver into paper and you can't
do that! You are always against heavenly commands. Therefore, Muslim people also must taste what other
people are tasting and it is a big blame for Muslim kings, amirs, and presidents to cheat people with paper
money.

I am a weak servant, but I am authorized to speak truth throughout the east and west, and make people wake
up! You must take away paper money and bring gold and silver. If not, there is never going to be change. You
must try to follow the commands of Heavens. If not, you are going to finish. May Allah forgive us. (Mawlana
Shaykh chants)
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah.
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah.
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah.

HasbunAllah wa ni`am al-wakil ni`am al-mawla wa ni`am al-naseer.
Fatihah
Tawbah astaghfirullah. Tawbah, astaghfirullah.
